content:
Nina Cheng: Quick sync — we need final decisions on audit-log schema v2 + RBAC for tenant visibility before we enable customer-facing exports for Private customers. Main asks: 1) schema changes (tenant_id mandatory + explicit schema version), 2) admin vs member visibility rules + scoped tokens, 3) validation/masking rules for events that are exposed to customers. any blockers?

Matt O'Leary: +1. my take: scoped tokens that encode allowed tenant_id(s) and event_type filters. API enforces token filter server-side so UI + export endpoints reuse same checks. :+1:

Sara Patel: Important callout — we currently log full_request_body in some flows (saw this in model uploads). that can have PII/API keys. we need field-level redaction in the export pipeline, not just UI hiding.

Josh Rivera: Agreed. proposed flow: keep v1 events as-is in internal store. emit v2 for external/export endpoints via transform that: 1) injects tenant_id (from request routing if missing), 2) applies allowlist of non-sensitive fields, 3) masks or hashes secrets. also add header "audit_schema":"v2" for consumers.

Kelsey Wu: From CS POV: customers want "who did what" and request context, but they also expect API keys masked. suggest we return sha256(api_key) or a token_hint instead of raw. also they want option to request full context if org-admin and contract allows.

audit-bot: audit-schema-checker: detected 2 events without tenant_id on staging since 1769988000 — see /staging/audit/errors (auto)

Nina Cheng: To make this concrete, here's an example v2 event we should validate against:
```json
{
  "audit_schema": "v2",
  "timestamp": "2026-06-20T15:23:10Z",
  "tenant_id": "org_123",
  "actor": {"id": "user_42", "role": "member", "auth": "token_scoped"},
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": {"id": "model_main", "type": "model", "old_version": "v1", "new_version": "v2"},
  "metadata": {"ip": "1.2.3.4"},
  "sensitive_masked": ["request_body","api_key"]
}
```

Nina Cheng: Validation rules proposal: tenant_id required and canonical format; actor.role in ["admin","member","service"]; resource.id + type required; no raw api_key/secret fields in exported events — if present they must be masked or replaced with sha256; allowlist for fields that can contain PII; events must include schema header and a signature field (signed by KMS/HSM per-tenant signing key) to let customers verify authenticity.

Matt O'Leary: Implementation notes: use KMS for per-tenant signing and optional field-level encryption. signature computed over canonicalized event (exclude signature field). scoped token format: claims = {iss, sub, aud:audit, tenant_id(s), scope:[audit:read], exp}. token middleware enforces tenant filter and event_type allowlist.

Josh Rivera: CI/testing: add JSON Schema (v2) to repo eng-security/audit-schemas and a contract test suite that runs in CI against staging. failing builds if staging emits non-compliant events. we can reuse the "audit-fixtures" harness to replay events and check transforms.

Sara Patel: KMS notes: we need envelope encryption for sensitive blobs and key rotation plan. also HSM-signed event signatures for customers that require tamper-evidence. ensure rotation includes re-signing policy for stored exports or publish key rotation metadata.

Kelsey Wu: UI question: default behavior for members vs admins? customers are confused if members see masked vs unmasked. recommend: default mask for members; org-admins with audit:unmask role can request unmasked view. make it a tenant policy toggle (off by default).

Nina Cheng: Agreed. default mask for members. role mapping: 
- org_admin: can see unmasked if tenant_policy.allow_unmask == true
- org_member: masked by default
- service/account: depends on scope
Also: scoped tokens for third-party integrations should always be limited to specific tenant ids and event types.

infra-bot: scheduled job created: audit-v2-migration-run at 2026-07-02T03:00:00Z (UTC) — will transform backlog and write audit_schema:v2 for new exports.

Matt O'Leary: small implementation detail — add endpoint param export.masking=explicit to let customers request masked-only exports even if they have unmask rights; defaults should honor tenant policy.

Josh Rivera: I'll add migration script to eng-infra/migrations/audit_v2_migrate and a one-off job to patch missing tenant_id using request routing logs.

Sara Patel: I'll compile a list of PII/sensitive fields we have observed (request_body, headers.cookie, headers.authorization, api_key, secrets.*) and share by EOD.

Kelsey Wu: I'll draft a customer-facing FAQ snippet about what appears in audit exports and the masking/role model.

Nina Cheng: Action items: I will draft RFC + JSON Schema + CI job PR by EOD Friday. Matt -> scoped token spec. Josh -> migrator + CI hook. Sara -> PII list. Kelsey -> customer comms. tagging folks: @Matt O'Leary @Josh Rivera @Sara Patel @Kelsey Wu. any final objections? :thumbsup:
